custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'smoothness' of the shark's skin. Real hammerheads have rough dermal denticles; if the image looks like smooth plastic, it is likely an AI artifact. Also, scrutinize the red area near the gills—is it blood/injury or geometric melting? Verify that the pectoral fins attach cleanly to the body without merging into the ventral surface.
